h: Daniel Bwala reportedly responds to the NDC's 2027 campaign council list
p: Presidential aide Daniel Bwala has reportedly reacted to the NDC's newly released campaign council, which features Peter Obi, Rabiu Kwankwaso and Governor Dickson. Details of his remarks were still emerging.
more: The NDC named the council earlier on Sunday.
The APC flagged off its own presidential campaign over the weekend.
